items.EventItemTitle: Subject:  Approval of the February 3, 2026 Cupertino Public Facilities Corporation special meeting minutes.
Subject: Annual Update on IRS Form 990 Filings and Regular Meeting Schedule

recordText: The agenda listed a Cupertino Public Facilities Corporation meeting scheduled for November 16, 2026. The agenda listed a routine approval of past meeting minutes and an annual update on the Corporation's federal tax filings and meeting schedule. The agenda listed approval of the minutes from the Corporation's February 3, 2026, special meeting on the Consent Calendar, which groups routine items for a single vote. The agenda listed an annual update on the Corporation's IRS Form 990 filings (the tax return filed by nonprofit organizations) and its regular meeting schedule.
